name: Implement signup flow
description: Implement an end-to-end signup flow: JavaFX client calls Local Server POST /api/auth/signup, Local Server persists the user in the local users table and emits a USER_REGISTERED outbox event, and the Central System idempotently creates the corresponding global user when it receives the sync event.

goal.answer: Implement an end-to-end signup flow: JavaFX client calls Local Server POST /api/auth/signup, Local Server persists the user in the local users table and emits a USER_REGISTERED outbox event, and the Central System idempotently creates the corresponding global user when it receives the sync event.

criteria.answer:
mvn test passes for shared/shared-dto, local-server, central-system and game-client-emulator modules
POST /api/auth/signup returns 201, persists a row in local_db.users, and creates a PENDING USER_REGISTERED outbox event
Local login (POST /api/auth/login) authenticates a user stored only in local_db.users and a user stored only in replicated_users
Central SyncReceiverService processes a USER_REGISTERED outbox event by creating a central_db.users row with the same userId and without generating a central replication outbox event
Duplicate USER_REGISTERED event ids and duplicate username/email conflicts are handled idempotently by the Central System
The JavaFX SignupView collects username/password/email, calls /api/auth/signup and navigates to LoginView on 201

constraints.answer: No new external dependencies, Preserve Central System /api/users public endpoint, Follow Clean Architecture / Hexagonal layering and DIP, Use the existing outbox + scheduler pattern for local-to-central propagation, Do not modify UserSyncDto (central-to-local replication contract), Update infrastructure/mysql-local/init.sql for the local users table unique constraints

phases.answer: Foundation - domain, shared DTOs and local persistence, Local signup application service and REST adapter, Central sync receiver user registration, JavaFX SignupView and navigation, Integration verification

assumptions.answer: The local users table already exists in the local MySQL schema with id, username, password_hash, email, roles, created_at; The local server generates the UUID for a new signup and the central system accepts that UUID; Local login checks replicated_users first, then users; The central replication scheduler will not push back users that originated from a local signup (achieved by suppressing the central outbox event for sync-origin registrations)

phases.name: Foundation - domain, shared DTOs and local persistence
phases.goal: Create the local signup domain contract, shared DTOs, JPA mapping for the local users table, and composite user lookup across replicated_users and users.
phases.description: Introduces domain ports/model/exception for local signup, SignupResponseDto/UserRegisteredEventDto in shared-dto, LocalUser JPA entity/repository/mapper/adapter, modifies UserRepositoryAdapter to query both tables, and updates the MySQL init script.

steps.description: Create local signup domain ports, model and exception
Create SignupResponseDto and UserRegisteredEventDto in shared-dto
Create LocalUser JPA entity, repository, mapper and adapter; modify UserRepositoryAdapter for composite lookup
Update infrastructure/mysql-local/init.sql with unique constraints on users.username and users.email
Write unit tests for LocalSignupUser and composite repository adapter

phases.name: Local signup application service and REST adapter
phases.goal: Implement LocalSignupService, expose POST /api/auth/signup and map domain exceptions to HTTP statuses.
phases.description: Builds the application service that hashes passwords, checks uniqueness, persists the local user and writes a USER_REGISTERED outbox event; wires it into AuthController; improves GlobalExceptionHandler.

steps.description: Enhance GlobalExceptionHandler for signup-related exceptions and update AuthControllerTest

phases.name: Central sync receiver user registration
phases.goal: Handle USER_REGISTERED outbox events in the Central System and idempotently create central users without generating a replication ping-pong.
phases.description: Adds RegisterUserFromSyncUseCase, implements registerFromSync in UserService, and extends SyncReceiverService.processEvent to parse and process USER_REGISTERED events.

steps.description: Implement registerFromSync in UserService without publishing replication outbox
Extend SyncReceiverService to process USER_REGISTERED events

phases.name: JavaFX SignupView and navigation
phases.goal: Add a signup screen in the client emulator and wire it to the login flow.
phases.description: Creates SignupView with username/password/email fields, modifies LoginView to offer a signup link, and updates MainView navigation.

steps.description: Wire SignupView into MainView and add signup link in LoginView
Add UI tests or note manual smoke-test evidence

verification.command: mvn test -pl game-client-emulator -am || echo 'Manual smoke test documented'

phases.name: Integration verification
phases.goal: Run module-level and end-to-end verification of the signup flow.
phases.description: Runs all affected module tests, starts the Docker databases/servers if feasible, and performs a manual signup/login smoke test.

steps.description: Run full test suite for all affected modules
Start infrastructure and Spring Boot apps, POST signup and verify local/central DB state

verification.command: Manual smoke-test checklist documented in chat
